Job Summary
We are looking for an Operations Analyst – eDiscovery with hands-on experience supporting end-to-end eDiscovery operations across the EDRM lifecycle. The role will involve data ingestion, processing, analysis, hosting, review support, quality control, and document production. The ideal candidate will have experience in end-to-end eDiscovery operations and/or Hosting & Production, along with hands-on expertise in Relativity and Nuix.

Key Responsibilities
- Support end-to-end eDiscovery workflows across the EDRM lifecycle (ingestion, processing, hosting, review support, QC, production).
- Process, load, search, analyze and manage ESI across multiple file formats.
- Work hands-on with Relativity, Nuix and other eDiscovery applications.
- Manage Hosting & Production workflows: data loading, workspace/database activities, searches, exports, document productions.
- Perform quality-control checks on processed data and deliverables.

Required Qualifications & Experience
- Bachelor's degree in IT, Computer Science, Law or a relevant field.
- Minimum 2+ years of experience in eDiscovery Operations.
- Hands-on experience with Relativity and Nuix.
- Good understanding of EDRM and the eDiscovery lifecycle.
- Understanding of eDiscovery data types, metadata, load files and document production workflows.
